query: What credible exogenous instruments or natural experiments (policy reforms, phased incentives, network shocks) can identify causal effects of each pre-commitment type on international performance?

response.query: What credible exogenous instruments or natural experiments (policy reforms, phased incentives, network shocks) can identify causal effects of each pre-commitment type on international performance?
response.answer: Policy reforms, phased incentives, and network shocks serve as credible exogenous instruments to identify causal effects of pre-commitment types on international performance. These methods provide clear, unbiased insights into the impact of such pre-commitments.
